title: Hack

objectives.text: Talk to Delroy, Penn Station cab line
Fare: up Sixth to Herald Square
objectives.hint: Sixth runs uptown. Cut over on 23rd, it's two-way.
Eighth runs uptown. Don't try Seventh.

objectives.text: Catch the fare who took the cash box
objectives.note: He runs down the 1974 one-ways; the route-knowledge shortcut is 41st St westbound.

objectives.text: Bring the cab back to Penn Station

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

rewards.payNote: Delroy's cab: fares and tips, after Delroy's cut.

mobile: No timers on fares (the meter is flavour). Wrong-way driving is allowed but honked at, and the fare complains, which teaches the one-ways without punishing. Hints are written as a 1974 New Yorker would give directions. The fare to 42nd St shows the Deuce's marquees for the first time.
design: P2 tutorial. Each fare follows one avenue's 1974 direction. On the last fare, Teddy passes a woman in an oxblood dress at 8th & W 40th (Delphine, unnamed). It's foreshadowing only, with no interaction. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act1_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
